vuln_statements.stmt_text: static int freader_get_folio(struct freader *r, loff_t file_off)
vuln_statements.explanation: This function declaration marks the entry point where folio handling occurs in the lib/buildid subsystem. According to the vulnerability root cause, read_cache_folio() was directly invoked within this function in a sleepable context, triggering NULL pointer dereference in filemap_read_folio. The surrounding context shows folio management operations (lines 34-38) including kunmap_local(), folio_put(), and folio nullification, indicating this is the critical code path where improper folio handling in sleepable context causes the vulnerability.
